Stripe is running a High School Fellowship in Software Engineering — a selective 12-week paid internship for current high school students or recent graduates, based in person in San Francisco or Seattle between May and August 2027. Fellows join a real product team and own a scoped engineering project end to end, contributing production code to Stripe's payments and financial infrastructure, alongside work in areas like fraud detection, payouts, and merchant checkout. The engineering work is primarily in Ruby, Java, JavaScript, Go, and Scala, with the expectation that strong fundamentals transfer to unfamiliar languages and systems.
